Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (the surface spans `packages/spec/src/**` and `packages/lint`; one card, one container), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate); review ceiling `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, reason: a widening of the published predicate contract on `packages/spec/src/**` (`contract-review.md`, 档随面定). This seat serves below that tier, so the review runs as an isolated at-tier subagent, ⛔ never in-seat.
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Basis for the Clause-② line: the diff's direction. Each of the card's three answers adds a meaning to the predicate surface's contract-bound roots (a bound row's meaning, a tier reading, a count read through the first), and nothing narrows. If the measured route declares nothing new, the dev reports that and this line is revisited before any PR.
Responsibility: whose code produces the risk: `packages/spec` names no contract-bound root for the row an `app` page's block binds, and names `features` as ambient only, so an author cannot write a `visibleWhen` that follows a bound count or the tier | the platform path that already covers it: none on `app` pages; `record` binds only when the page has a row | who reaches it: any `app` page that gates a block on bound data or on the plan; the control plane's environments page is the ruled pull
Thread-read: none
Ruling-ref: objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 Q2 = B (「同意」, director batch #362), as the card body quotes it: `visibleWhen` must follow the organisation's tier and the bound count. The mechanism is the seat's call, spec first, with no root that only the control plane could fill. This session cannot read that repository; the card's quote is the scope.
Serial constraints cleared:
- All 3 open PRs' file lists were read in this act (#24262, #24260, #24168); none touches these files.
- In-flight claims in the lane (#15204, #23566, #23561) and `domain:engine`'s declared #24197 (`validate-expressions.ts`, `rule-explanations.ts`) name none of these files, except `rule-explanations.ts`, held off above.
- The surface is not governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs --test`: 0 of 4 paths).
- Prior rulings: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 24265` names ADR-0068 D1 (one predicate evaluates identically in a formula, an RLS policy and a client gate) and ADR-0089 among its hits. The route must not contradict either; the dev reads both before choosing.
